---
title: "Normalverteilung – Quantil"
params:
  lang: de
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(exams)
library(mathml)
library(htmltools)
library(mistakes)

hook(sigma2, sigma^2L)

task <- "normal_quantile"
plfile <- file.path("rexams", sprintf("%s.pl", task))
rolog::consult(system.file(plfile, package="mistakes"))

## DATA GENERATION
repeat
{
  mu <- round(runif(1, min = 40, max = 60), 1)
  sigma <- round(runif(1, min = 5, max = 15), 1)
  p <- round(runif(1, min = 0.1, max = 0.9), 2)

  Q <- quote(
    search(
      normal_quantile,
      normal_quantile(p, mu, sigma^2L, sigma),
      .S, .R, .P, .E
    )
  )

  S <- findall(
    Q,
    options = list(preproc = as.rolog),
    env = environment()
  )

  if(problems(S))
    next

  break
}

t <- prepare(task=task, S)
sol <- format_feedback(
  t$correct, t$explanations, t$praise, t$blame, t$extra
)
```

Aufgabe
========

Wir betrachten die Normalverteilung $X \sim N\left(\mu=`r sprintf("%.1f", mu)`, \sigma^2=`r sprintf("%.1f", sigma^2)`\right)$. 

Welches $x$ ist größer als $p=$ `r round(p * 100)`% der Realisierungen?

```{r questionlist, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
exams::answerlist(t$alternatives, markup="markdown")
```

Lösung
========

Das `r round(p *100)`%-Quantil wird berechnet durch: `r t$solution`

```{r solutionlist, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
sol <- lapply(sol, FUN=gsub, pattern="\\n", replacement="")
answerlist(sol, markup="markdown")
```
